educationalGoal:
(1) Learn basic theory and method for robotics control.
(2) Deepen understanding and develop robotics application capabilities.
(3) Learn the skills needed to perform experiments and write reports.
(4) Learn how to arrange and present the content, results, and discussion in a report.
advice:
This is a course of lab exercises in robotics. We will cover the following topics:
1. Dynamic behavior
Students will deepen their understanding of the basis of vibration analysis of one- and two-degree-of-freedom vibration systems. In particular, students will measure the amplitude and phase of a vibration system affected by time-varying force to measure the vibration of the experimental apparatus. Students will learn the basic theory of a dynamic vibration absorber.
2. Robot control 1
Students will learn the operation of robot simulator and then program a robotic arm.
3. Robot control 2
Students will learn feedback control and programming. A driving circuit and a computer will be installed on the robot that was built in the previous course, Engineering Exercises for Robotics I.
4. Fundamentals and practice of reinforcement learning
Students will learn the fundamentals and implementation of reinforcement learning through both simulation experiments and real-world experiments using an inverted pendulum system.
